title: Restore everything on Joomla swaps tables that carry triggers (no MariaDB 1435)
steps: S1: Common setup (tests/regression/README.md § Common setup): O, seat A's cookie, api, pq.

S2: Pick S = a Joomla site A owns where Restore everything is allowed (scv2 stand: qa1jo01.scv2.tracy.test; never scv2*); L = the part of S before the first '.'; define jdb() { printf '%s\n' "$1" | docker exec -i <L>-db-1 sh -c 'MYSQL_PWD="$MARIADB_ROOT_PASSWORD" mariadb -uroot -N -B joomla'; }.

S3: Record T0 = jdb "SELECT trigger_name, event_object_table FROM information_schema.triggers WHERE trigger_schema='joomla' ORDER BY 1" and P = docker exec <L>-web-1 php -r 'require "/var/www/html/configuration.php"; echo (new JConfig)->dbprefix;'.
S4: Run api a POST /api/sites/<S>/backup '{"title":"REG-003-point","notes":""}'; record N = body.version.

S5: Set U = 'reg003u' + unix seconds; run docker exec -web-1 php /var/www/html/cli/joomla.php user:add --username= --name='REG 003 after' --password='Reg003-after-pass-1' --email=@example.test --usergroup=Registered; record U0 = jdb "SELECT count(*) FROM

users WHERE username=''".

S7: Record pq "select action,status,coalesce(error,'') from site_operation where site_key='<S>' order by created_at desc limit 1"; T1 = the S3 trigger query again; U1 = the S5 count again; R = jdb "SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.schemata WHERE schema_name='joomla_tracy_restore'"; api a GET /api/sites/<S>/backups; F = curl -sL -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} %{num_redirects} %{url_effective}' <front page of S> (scv2 stand: http://<L>.scv2.tracy.test:34080/; follow redirects: a multilingual Joomla answers / with 301 to /en/).
expect:
S3: T0 has ≥ 1 row (Claude Cowork Joomla plugin sites: 4 — tr_cc_content_article_delete/insert on

content, tr_cc_content_shared_delete/insert on

modules); 0 rows → BLOCKED (fixture missing), never PASS.
S6: HTTP 200, ok true, status 'succeeded', version == N (pre-fix: HTTP 409 {code:'RESTORE_REFUSED', reason:'RESTORE_FAILED'}; host job output 'ERROR 1435 (HY000): Trigger in wrong schema').
S7: latest site_operation: action 'restore-everything', status 'succeeded', error empty (pre-fix: 'restore-everything | failed | RESTORE_FAILED').
S7: T1 == T0 (same trigger names on the same tables, so the point's trigger set is live again).
S7: U1 == 0 (the swap ran); R == 0 (scratch schema dropped).

S7: /backups has a row kind 'backup', auto 'pre-restore', version N+1, database.state 'full'; F ends in HTTP 200 after following redirects (a 301 from / to a language page such as /en/ is the site's normal answer, before and after the restore; compare with the same curl before S4 if in doubt).
evidence: tasks/evidence/site-changes-v2/qa/r1/bugs/QA-I10-r2.md (fix 83b2a02bd); the QA note is Studio-local (not in git), the fix commit is on develop
fence: webroot-backup.sh restore_mysql (packages/fleet/tracy-fleet-operation/scripts/webroot) moves tables bare: tracy_db_triggers_sql/tracy_db_drop_triggers (lib/site-backup.sh) save and drop both schemas' triggers before the single RENAME TABLE, then tracy_db_load_triggers loads the restored set.
